additional_info.subject: 0427104 - ID0427104-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / N0 160382417 ERK] Charger not available CRM:00472000311
additional_info.body:
Dear support team,
I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to provide an update regarding the events you reported on May 27th.
As per our investigation we observed that the charger received a hard reboot command from the backend on May 27th and 30th.
The charger's behavior of opening the main circuit breaker and sending this information to the backend via OCPP is a normal and expected response when receiving a reboot command. There are no issues with the charger itself.
Please let me know if you have any further questions or concerns. I will proceed to close this support ticket, but do not hesitate to reach out if similar events occur in the future.
Thank you.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.

201, Avenida 25 de Abril
2845-547 Corroios, Portugal
